facts.fact: BOCRA's 2024 annual report (year to March 2024) says the regulator engages regionally under the Communications Regulators' Association of Southern Africa framework, and its 2024-2029 strategic plan is aligned with the CRASA Strategic Plan 2023-2028; the document gives no event date, so the published year 2024 is used.
facts.system: Communications Regulators' Association of Southern Africa (CRASA)

facts.fact: BOCRA's 2024 annual report (year to March 2024) says the regulator engages continentally through the African Telecommunications Union; the document gives no event date, so the published year 2024 is used.
